_note: Gu Broadcasting Station newsroom. Every on-air character is AI-rendered (HeyGen Avatar III); fill heygen ids via `python -m gbs heygen-list`. heygen.speed is the operator (Kai Love) read-speed knob. style/sample shape tone only -- never facts. shows use GBS_TZ local time; render_quarters = which quarter-hours (0-3) of each hour render video.
